title: node.py: fragment detection uses hardcoded rule IDs instead of RULE_IDS constant
description:
Line 865 uses hardcoded values (0x78, 0x79) for fragment detection instead of the imported RULE_IDS constant from lichen.schc.fragment. If RULE_IDS changes, this code would silently become inconsistent.

Location: python/src/lichen/node.py:865
Current: is_fragment = bool(payload) and payload[0] in (0x78, 0x79)
Fix: is_fragment = bool(payload) and payload[0] in RULE_IDS

Severity: P2 - maintenance/correctness risk
close_reason: Already fixed; node.py:87 imports RULE_IDS from lichen.schc.fragment, line 102 uses data[0] not in RULE_IDS.
